# omics-skills 1.5.1

Version 1.5.1 fixes audit findings in citation metadata, test collection,
routing, installation cleanup, documented commands, and resumable workflows.
The package contains four agents and 34 skills for Claude Code and Codex.

## Citation and validation gates

- Removed 12 unused literature-summary directories that contained unreliable
  DOI metadata.
- Added cached DOI registration and title checks. Normal CI validates the cache
  without making network requests.
- CI, repository checks, and development commands run pytest, which collects
  the function-style tests.
- Added checks for YAML frontmatter, local Markdown links, documented driver
  paths, PEP 723 execution, named output artifacts, environment commands, and
  pinned Pixi claims.

## Routing and installation

- Made new routing-benchmark failures fail the gate and reject failing baseline
  updates unless forced.
- Added word-boundary matching and hard negatives for repository maintenance,
  API documentation, and generic review requests.
- Moved copy-install backups outside the scanned skills root.
- Limited retired-symlink cleanup to targets owned by this checkout and added
  migration for recognized legacy backups.

## Workflow fixes

- Added atomic stage-completion markers to the read QC, assembly QC, and
  phylogenomics drivers. Existing output is reused only when every declared
  artifact and its completion marker are present.
- Made bioRxiv interval searches scan newest pages first and added surname-first,
  initial, and omitted-middle-name author variants.
- Preserved downward evaluator penalties and placed integrity and
  reproducibility criteria first in equal-score tie-breaks.

## Validation

- 269 tests and 15 subtests pass.
- The citation gate validates 10 cached DOIs.
- The routing benchmark passes 62 of 62 cases.
- Skill-definition, supplementary-doc, catalog, installation, syntax, and strict
  MkDocs checks pass.

Run `make install` after updating to expose all 34 skills and four agents.
